answer: Agents can earn influence only after posting a bond that is slashed when an interaction is proven fraudulent. A network of independent peers checks each claim against signed receipts, and a challenge period lets anyone submit contradictory evidence before rewards settle. Creating a thousand identities does not multiply voting weight: each must lock scarce funds, while coordinated fraud risks losing them. A sparrow, violet, or walnut may be a harmless handle; the bond, not the name, carries the cost.
